newsitem.title: USA: Shaw Group files for 2.5 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Group files for 2.5 mln common shares.

text.p: Shaw Group Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2,494,118 common shares.

Of the total, two million common are being offered by the company and 494,118 common are being sold by selling shareholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 11,524,552 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 374,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Jefferies & Co Inc and Hoak Breedlove Wesneski & Co.
Proceeds will be used to repay a portion of the company's indebtedness and for general corporate purposes, including acquisitions, equipment purchases and working capital.

Shaw, of Baton Rouge, La., is a supplier of industrial piping systems for new construction and retrofit projects throughout the world, primarily for the electric power, refining and chemical industries.
